candidates.review_note: A folded stick is level two for the current song, level one for the next, then expires even if unused. State consists of total sticks folded and how many were folded one song ago. For each number of newly folded sticks, independently maximize current satisfaction over all old/new shaking counts totaling at most eight, including the separate no-shaking reward. Never fold more than eight in one song: the same eight can be shaken both now and next song, so extra simultaneously folded sticks cannot improve either song. Enumerate skip/unshaken choices naturally and keep negative optima when all choices lose satisfaction.
